references.text: Beer-sheba as a sacred meeting place for sacrifice and God's presence during transitional moments for the patriarchs.
Contrast between Abraham's peaceful return and Elijah's flight in fear, both at Beer-sheba.
Contrast between Abraham's loss (Hagar) and restoration (return) at Beer-sheba.
21:31 explains the meaning of the name and place (covenant), providing context for Abraham's settlement in 22:19.
